description: ACCIDENTES DE TRANSITO CON INFORME POLICIAL - MADRID, CUNDINAMARCA is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Madrid, Cundinamarca. Este conjunto presenta los accidentes de tránsito registrados en el municipio de Madrid con informe policial, incluyendo fecha, lugar, tipo de accidente, vehículos involucrados y número de víctimas. La información permite analizar la seguridad vial y apoyar políticas de prevención. Coverage: Alcaldía de Madrid, Cundinamarca. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Madrid, Cundinamarca. Its tags are seguridad vial. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2026-03-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
